}}'''Lindsar''' is an [[Ogier]] woman who is the eldest of the Ogier in [[Stedding Sholoon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lindsar}} Though she was too old to fight in the [[Last Battle]], she allowed [[Androl Genhald]] and [[Pevara Tazanovni]] to use the ''[[stedding]]'' to trap a group of [[Darkfriends]], including [[Alviarin Freidhen]], some of [[Mazrim Taim|Mazrim Taim’s]] cronies, and some [[Aes Sedai]] and [[Asha'man]] who had been [[Turned]] to the [[Shadow]]. She thought that a few decades in the peace of the ''stedding'' might change their outlook.

== Trivia ==
* Lindsar is named for Lindsay Johnson, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
